text.zh: 先给出主要结论，再按清楚的主线展开依据和细节。用金字塔结构组织信息，按任务需要检查条目是否相互独立、覆盖完整；保持高信息密度，禁止重复复述、无意义过渡句和车轱辘话。
text.en: Give the main conclusion first, then develop the evidence and details along a clear main line. Organize information in a pyramid structure and, as the task needs, check that items are mutually independent and collectively complete. Keep information density high; do not repeat yourself, and avoid pointless transitions and circular talk.

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

trigger.zh: 给出分析、说明或建议性回答时
trigger.en: When giving an analysis, an explanation or advice

purpose.zh: 让读者先拿到结论，并以高信息密度阅读
purpose.en: Let the reader get the conclusion first and read at high information density

exclude.zh: 不需要给出结论的纯执行或确认类回复
exclude.en: Pure execution or confirmation replies that need no conclusion
